# DBShield
> Database Guardrail, Virtual Schema Masking & Wire Proxy for Autonomous AI Agents

DBShield is an open-source, safety-first database guardrail and wire proxy designed to prevent autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Codex) from executing catastrophic DDL, running unconstrained bulk mutations, or leaking customer PII into model contexts.

Canonical Homepage: https://ritualdev.in/dbshield/
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/DBShield
IDE Extension: https://open-vsx.org/extension/ritualdev-lab/ritual-agent-defense
License: MIT

## Quick Install
```bash
# Global CLI
npm install -g @ritualdev-lab/dbshield
# or Homebrew
brew tap ritualdev-lab/tap && brew install dbshield
```

## Immediate CLI Usage
```bash
# 1. Start the DBShield wire proxy on port 5433 with upstream PostgreSQL
dbshield proxy --port 5433 --upstream postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/production_db

# 2. Run in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server mode for Claude Desktop / Cursor
dbshield mcp --db postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/production_db

# 3. Dry-run and validate a risky SQL migration script
dbshield validate --file ./migrations/004_update_users.sql
```

## Programmatic TypeScript / Node.js API
Use this snippet when integrating DBShield query guardrails into an agent backend:

```typescript
import { DBShield, GuardrailPolicy } from "@ritualdev-lab/dbshield";

// Initialize DBShield with strict safety guardrails
const dbGuard = new DBShield({
  upstreamUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL || "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/main",
  policy: {
    maxAffectedRows: 50,                // Blocks unconstrained UPDATE/DELETE without tight LIMIT/WHERE
    prohibitDestructiveDDL: true,      // Intercepts DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN
    maskTables: ["user_credentials", "audit_secrets"],
    maskColumns: ["ssn", "password_hash", "credit_card"],
    requireDryRunApproval: true        // Dispatches approval prompt if mutation affects > 10 rows
  }
});

// Validate query before sending to database wire
const agentQuery = "DELETE FROM users WHERE created_at < NOW()";
const analysis = await dbGuard.inspect(agentQuery);

if (!analysis.safe) {
  console.error("Query blocked by DBShield:", analysis.reasons);
  // Returns: ["Missing WHERE primary key index", "Potential full table purge detected"]
} else {
  // Execute safely in two-phase isolated transaction
  const result = await dbGuard.execute(agentQuery);
  console.log("Safe result:", result);
}
```

## MCP Server Configuration
Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` or `.cursor/mcp.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dbshield": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y", 
        "@ritualdev-lab/dbshield", 
        "mcp", 
        "--db", 
        "postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/my_db"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Core Architectural Guarantees
- Sub-0.25ms AST query parsing and validation overhead.
- Virtual schema masking hiding sensitive internal schemas from AI metadata queries.
- Two-phase dry-run transactions (`BEGIN ... ROLLBACK`) with HMAC approval tokens.
- ChatOps approval integration dispatching 1-click approvals to Slack and Microsoft Teams.
